title: Thick-walled cylinder under internal pressure, 2D plane strain (Lamé)
source: Lamé's solution, Timoshenko and Goodier, Theory of Elasticity, 3rd ed., McGraw-Hill 1970, §28

quantities.reason: quadratic elements on 8 radial divisions resolve u_r = A r + B/r to well under 0.1%

quantities.quantity: hoop stress σ_θ = σ_yy at the bore (10, 0)
quantities.reason: stress extrapolated to the bore surface and averaged over two elements: about 0.5%

quantities.quantity: axial stress σ_zz = 2νA at the bore (plane strain)
quantities.reason: σ_zz = ν(σ_r + σ_θ) follows the in-plane stresses, extrapolated as they are
